request.message:
Add isolated native root JWT custody and Token API composition

Retain one real JWT verification through request-local lifetime custody, actual Identity finalization, native publication and audited delivery. Admit the root local-key service-token profile and reuse the existing Token API child and batch issuer contracts with closed parent/provenance checks.

Add fifteen independent regression sources, preserving the original ten R1 tests and all existing qualified denominators. This is an unformatted, uncompiled source candidate; actual formatter/build/test and official JWT ACL parity gates remain outstanding. No current validation or production ref is changed.
